[S5] Every result derives from parsed source plus tsc/regex helper answers over the same program. Auto type mode silently degrades to declaration-only types when node/typescript is missing (main.rs:213-224), so results depend on the environment; see S5-11 (G42).

[S5] A Known node's cost is a bound only if every contribution is proven. Part carries no per-contribution proven/unknown split. A partial cost that counted an unknown-multiplicity loop body once (walker.rs:1566-1590 scales only the unknowns by None; cost stays body_main) is reported as a floor-like cost and fails lint, which no bound or floor justifies. Assertion-dependence is not tracked, so 'every instance where each assertion holds' cannot be stated. See S5-1 (G4), S5-4 (G33).

tests: tests/integration/directives.rs (an_open_target_* tests; none asserts the Known state of a directive cost)
clauses.note: [S5] tagged_reading_of yields Part::unmarked(cost, None) with no unknowns, so a fully resolved @perf O(...) node is Known with that cost. When a quantity is unresolved (bind_known returns unresolved=true) a SizeRelation unknown is joined and the node is Partial (walker.rs:479-497, summaries.rs:2424-2436) rather than Known. opaque_effects_at is also folded into current_effects.unknown_global (walker.rs:442), which can lower other nodes. See S5-3 (G40).

[S5] Arenas intern by structure, join children are sorted, and report ordering is total (cost key, file, line, name). Environment-dependent typing is S5-11 (G42). [S6] Regex answers depend on wall-clock timeout (10 s per pattern, passed to recheck at regex.rs:332) and a 120 s batch deadline shared by every pattern, so a slower machine turns later patterns into Exhausted/ResourceExhaustion. Scheduler wake order iterates std HashSet (RandomState) waiters and dependencies, so task evaluation order, specialization admission under the per-function cap and the point of budget exhaustion can differ between identical runs (suspected; confirm by repeated runs). See S6-22 (G30), S6-23 (G29).

[S5] The unknown policy is read only at main.rs:354-379 (exit code and diagnostic severity), and --min only filters report rows (report.rs:296-318), so state and cost are identical across policies and --min (stdout equality tested in both modes). Report and lint differ: lint joins a Comparison unknown into part.unknowns for Inconclusive comparisons (main.rs:290-317), making a Known entry Partial in lint but Known in report; report adds a ResourceExhaustion unknown only when the envelope bind fails (report.rs:134-146); marked functions use summarize_with(raw) in report but summarize in lint (report.rs:127-130). See S5-6 (G32).

[S5] No Within verdict exists. CostComparison::Within orders costs only and never consults Part state, so a Partial or Unknown entry whose counted cost is at or below the limit is treated as Within instead of Inconclusive, and the Known requirement is never checked. See S5-2 (G31).
[S5] Exceeds fires on part.cost regardless of state. For Known nodes it is a proven bound; for Partial nodes the cost is not a proven floor (S5-1 (G4)). Ceilings are not implemented (action 7.3).
[S5] Inconclusive exists only as cost-incomparable (Comparison unknown). Partial or Unknown entries that do not Exceed are not classified Inconclusive per entry. See S5-2 (G31).
[S5] An Exceeds line reads '<cost> [partial] > <limit>  name  loc  via entry' with no statement that it is what olint proves (bound or floor) and that an instance may fall below it. See S5-5 (G43).
[S5] Lint exits 1 iff some entry compares Exceeds against an applicable limit. What counts as Exceeds is S5-1 (G4).

[S5] Under error the exit is 1 iff any unknown origin exists in selected_unknowns, which includes origins of Exceeds or Within entries and public-coverage unknowns (main.rs:260) that belong to no entry. It does not depend on an entry being Inconclusive. See S5-2 (G31), S5-10 (G41).

[S5] Implemented: bound/floor text with '[partial]' when part.unknowns is set; '[@perf <cost>]' mark for a function-level cost directive; each unknown origin rendered with reason, file:line span, multiplicity and call path. Missing: an explicit Unknown state (an all-unknown node prints 'O(1) [partial]', tested at unknowns.rs:83), an asserted mark for every asserted node (ignore, bounded, hot, cold, statement-level cost and dependents are unmarked), and floor versus bound. Origins go to stderr only and are suppressed under ignore, so the report itself lacks them. See S5-4 (G33), S5-7 (G34).

[S5] Accepts exactly ignore, warn, error; absent gives Warn (config.rs:36 and #[default]); other values fail with ConfigError::Unknown (main.rs:104-106). No dedicated test of the invalid value or the absent default exit path was found; see S5-9.

[S5] Per-origin diagnostics: none under ignore, 'olint: warning:' under warn, 'olint: error:' under error, deduplicated by text; stdout identical across policies in lint and report (tested). Gaps: diagnostics are per unknown origin, not per Inconclusive entry, and comparison diagnostics exist only in lint; the Comparison unknown alters lint stdout (S5-6 (G32)). See S5-10 (G41).

[S6] Per-node work is not constant: unbounded recording rounds re-walk every discovered function per round, every round re-creates the whole ts.Program, per-query checker work grows with union/member/overload width, nested loops re-prepass their bodies, and several set operations are linear-scan. See S6-1 (G59)..S6-11 (G68), S6-17 (G74)..S6-21 (G75), S6-24 (G64).
[S6] Charges are per-event totals with no node; whole-file GraphNode charges land on whichever node first asks; body-size work is reserved per task, not per node. See S6-14 (G63).

[S6] Totals are O(R*|G|) with R recording rounds up to the number of dependent sites, plus uncounted superlinear work in project loading, tsconfig selection, public surface discovery and effect joins. Program-global caps bound some counters per pass but not rounds or uncounted work. See S6-1 (G59), S6-3 (G61), S6-12 (G67), S6-15 (G80).

[S6] Nodes fall to Unknown(ResourceExhaustion) when program-global per-pass budgets run out, which depends on unrelated program size rather than on a scaling family showing per-node growth; other results do not stand independently of order. See S6-12 (G67), S6-13 (G83), S6-26 (G82).

[S6] Scheduler counts are deterministic per pass but reset each pass; TscCounts are per run, never requested in production, and count only span indexing; no memory counts exist; tests accept x3 per doubling and fit on three points. See S6-5 (G78), S6-15 (G80), S6-16 (G79), S6-25 (G81).
